_note: Pickup special weapons. Weapon crates in the arena hand out 'crate_amount' of a random one.
_curve_note: curve_deg_per_s bends a shot gently toward a target inside view_cone_deg of where it is heading: about a tenth of the Seeker's turn rate. Leave both out for a dead-straight weapon.

seeker.name: Seeker
seeker.description: Homing rocket. Follows whatever it was locked on to.

firebrand.name: Firebrand
firebrand.description: Fast rocket that leaves the target burning. Bends slightly toward a target ahead.

sledge.name: Sledge
sledge.description: Slow, heavy warhead. Flies dead straight. Huge damage and a hard shove.

satchel.name: Satchel
satchel.description: Canvas bag of blasting charge. Tap to lay up to three behind you; press again a second later to set them all off. Left alone, they blow after 8 s.

tar_pot.name: Tar Pot
tar_pot.description: A lobbed canister of burning tar. Bursts into a wide pool of fire.

skipper.name: Skipper
skipper.description: A bomb that bounces off floors and walls up to three times, then blows. Hits a car and it blows at once.

arc_coil.name: Arc Coil
arc_coil.description: A bolt of current to the car ahead that jumps on to the car nearest it. Both lose their turbo for 2 s.
